title: Quick Steamed Malaysian Broccoli Sushi
description: A kid-friendly Malaysian dish featuring purple-sprouting-broccoli and macrobiotic-friendly ingredients, served in an agave leaf vessel. This dish is fatty and has a glassy-jelly texture.
instructions: Rinse the purple-sprouting-broccoli and cut it into small florets.
Steam the broccoli florets in a steamer basket for 5 minutes.
Prepare the short-grain-rice according to the package instructions.
Mix the cooked rice with rice-vinegar, sesame-oil, and sea-salt.
Cut the nori-sheets into small squares.
Assemble the sushi by placing a small amount of rice onto a nori square and topping it with steamed broccoli.
Shape the sushi into nigiri shapes using your hands.
Place the sushi onto a fresh agave leaf and serve immediately.
